name: Apple & Onion
description: In a world of talking food, best mates Apple and Onion fumble through city life, tackling ordinary problems by extraordinary means.

credits_cast.character: Chicken Nugget / Chicken Drumstick / Beef Jerky (voice)
credits_cast.name: Kevin Michael Richardson

credits_cast.character: Hoagie / Ice Cream / Candy Cookie / Tap Water (voice)
credits_cast.name: Roger Craig Smith

videos.title: Apple & Onion (Pilot)
videos.overview: Apple and Onion accidentally get invited to Hot Dog's party. The duo are excited, specifically Onion as he wants to get close with French Fry, but when Burger tries to dissuade them by saying it is a "more grown up party", they decide that they need to grow up which somehow lands them in jail.

videos.title: Lift
videos.overview: Apple and Onion elevate your minds whilst 'elevating' a Hoagie, in an elevator (or 'lift').

videos.title: Buff Up My Head
videos.overview: How to look good for a party!, Apple and Onion styyyle!

videos.title: Nothing Else
videos.overview: Apple and Onion play the super famous, smash hit 'start-with-the-word-you-ended-with-uses-for-objects' game!

videos.title: Sleep
videos.overview: Apple and Onion show you how to get a good nights, pure, 100% sleep.

videos.title: Water
videos.overview: Drink up this song by Apple and Onion (If you're thirsty and want a song drink).

videos.title: Car
videos.overview: Do you ever sing along to car alarms? Apple and Onion do, and pay the ultimate price!

videos.title: Pizza Party
videos.overview: Apple and Onion throw a raging 3 person party! (maybe 4)

videos.title: Goodbye
videos.overview: It's always hard saying goodbye but Apple and Onion will help you through the tough times with nice songs.

videos.title: George Gendi Interview
videos.overview: Interview with Apple and Onion creator, George Gendi.

videos.title: A New Life
videos.overview:
Apple and Onion are separately sent off to a new life in the city by their respective parents. Apple is to find an apartment that is ready for him through a map, while Onion has free housing waiting through his job at Fun Co. Upon making it to the city, the two find that what can go wrong will go wrong, and eventually find their journeys intertwined.

Songs: "Take It One Step at a Time" & "I Will Make Friends"

videos.title: The Perfect Team
videos.overview:
During a computer game-playing session, \"perfect team\" Apple and Onion find themselves with a new roommate pawing at their window: a cat. It loves to roost upon Apple's head, but seems to hate Onion because of his hair; causing tension between who spends more time with Apple.

Songs: "Level 99" & "Wake Up Song"

videos.title: Tips
videos.overview:
Apple and Onion desire to be on a balloon ride, they gather all the change they can but it's not enough. Desperate to get on the ride, they work to get tips from customers at the pizza place where Pizza works, they start to scare off customers, but then realize they need to do this by being polite to the customers.

Songs: "What Shall We Do Today" & "Have Some Tips Song"

videos.title: Falafel's Fun Day
videos.overview:
Apple and Onion decide to show their landlord Falafel an amazing day when he starts to feel homesick and after getting him mad when they didn't listen to his warnings about the air conditioner, things don't go the way they intended, however.

Songs: "He Fix It" & "Apple and Onion and Me"

videos.title: Apple's in Trouble
videos.overview:
Apple is challenged to a fight by a grumpy Cheesesteak after Apple yells at Lemondrop, so he and Onion go on a quest to find the source of Cheesesteak's grumpiness by using the clues for a “chain reaction”. This quest starts from the hotel, then into a room, then into a kitchen, then into the sewers, then into another room, then into Edwards School.

Song: "Classic Domino Chain Reversal Song"

videos.title: 4 on 1
videos.overview:
When Burger and Hot Dog notice Onion has some pro basketball skills, they decide to ask if he and Apple would be interested to join their team for the big 4 on 4 tournaments, they accept, but Onion starts to lose for the team when he finds the voices in his head keep throwing him off and making him nervous.

Song: "Onion's Talent Song"

videos.title: Hotdog's Movie Premiere
videos.overview:
Apple and Onion are banned from the premiere of their friend Hot Dog's new movie he's in: Robotot II, so they try many attempts to sneak in. Their plans involve hiding in Popcorn to get in the bathroom so they can get into the booth, using objects to fool Chicken Nugget (a police-guard), disguising themselves as dogs, and using dipping sauce.

Songs: "Sorry, Chicken Nugget" & "How's Anyone Gonna Respect Me?"

videos.title: Bottle Catch
videos.overview:
Apple and Onion invent a new game called bottle catch (tossing a water bottle back and forth). When Energy Bar hears about it, she steals the idea. In order to get everyone to buy the many water bottles they need to sell, they try to interest them in the bottles by having a bottle catch contest against Energy Bar and Whey.

Songs: "Bottle Catch Song" & "Rhythm of the Cat"

videos.title: Pancake’s Bus Tour
videos.overview:
When Apple loses his shoe, Onion takes him on a guided bus tour to a shooting star show to have him wish for his shoe. But on the bus, Apple must learn to try and stay serious so they won't get kicked off the bus.

Songs: "Where's Apple's Shoe?" & "Hopping Along"

videos.title: Block Party
videos.overview:
Apple and Onion are getting ready for a block party with all their friends, but a mischievous duck takes over their roof. When they are unable to get into the house because they're stuck with the duck, they try to outwit it before the cake they baked for the party melts and destroys their laptop, which holds the song they wrote for the party.

Song: "We're Having a Block Party"

videos.title: Apple's Focus
videos.overview:
Apple tries to help Onion achieve his life long dream of being on a cook show as he is a skilled home chef, he is however scared that Apple will ruin his opportunity. Apple then ruins his opportunity and they lose the recipe but it's found out that Apple had made a song containing all the ingredients of the cake that Onion was planning to make.

Songs: "Recipe"

videos.title: Lil' Noodle
videos.overview:
Apple and Onion walk down the side walk in a "wicked style", a famous rapper notices their slick moves and decides to have them be background characters in an upcoming music video. These hopes for the duo are later complicated as a bird decides to nest in Onion's hair.

Songs: "Wicked Style"

videos.title: Gyranoid of the Future
videos.overview:
The duo try to ride a new thrill ride at the amusement park, but the curator of an old ride keeps interfering.

Songs: "Carnival Song"

videos.title: Fun Proof
videos.overview: The duo compete to get their picture on the diner wall as the "most fun people".

videos.title: Whale Spotting
videos.overview: In order to see a rare whale, Apple and Onion have to become members of an exclusive club, but one of them doesn't quite have the chops.

videos.title: Heatwave
videos.overview:
The duo try to cheer up the residents of a retirement home during a heat wave.

Songs: "It's Very Very Hot"

videos.title: Apple's in Charge
videos.overview:
For once, Apple is put in charge of the dollar store. But his ideas to make money keep failing.

Songs: "Dollar"

videos.title: Burger's Trampoline
videos.overview:
The duo pretend to like Burger's boring card game show so that they can use his trampoline.

Songs: "His Name Is"

videos.title: Baby Boi TP
videos.overview:
Apple dreams of constructing a complex sculpture out of toilet paper, but needs a lifetime supply to finish it.

Songs: "Onion Anyway"

videos.title: Not Funny
videos.overview:
Apple becomes very jealous of Cotton Candy when she and Onion hit it off as friends.

Songs: "Cotton Candy and Onion" and "Apple and Apple"

videos.title: Onionless
videos.overview:
When Onion is absent, Apple must take care of his plant. But a TV show distracts him.

Songs: "Clean Apple's Sock"

videos.title: Party Popper
videos.overview:
A grumpy (and bossy) guest joins a party in Apple and Onion's shack. The duo try to prevent his most disliked factor, singing, from happening.

Songs: "Anyways Smile"

videos.title: Face Your Fears
videos.overview: The duo promise to be by French Fry's side so that she can face her fears and recite her poetry. But then they end up locked in a pet store.

videos.title: Apple's Short
videos.overview:
Apple becomes convinced that a movie star is his true love. But then he realizes to her dislike that he's short.

Songs: "Onion's Happiness"

videos.title: Positive Attitude Theory
videos.overview:
The duo bet Falafel that they can handle his job for a day with their positive attitude.

Songs: "Apple's Songs"

videos.title: Follow Your Dreams
videos.overview:
The duo get duped by a commercial into believing that their dream is to be professional pet groomers.

Songs: "Take it One Step at the Time"

videos.title: Sausage and Sweetie Smash
videos.overview: Apple and Onion try to control their obsessions of sausages and a video game, respectively.

videos.title: Selfish Shellfish
videos.overview: The duo try to prove Shellfish wrong when she claims that they do good deeds just to selfishly gain praise.

videos.title: Apple's Formula
videos.overview: Tater Tot wants to put Apple in his new movie because he thinks Apple is "naturally funny". This sends Apple on a quest to determine the formula that makes him funny.

videos.title: River of Gold
videos.overview: The duo become obsessed with reading an old book on display at the museum. But Chicken Nugget has to guard the book in order to get his police job back.

videos.title: Appleoni
videos.overview: The duo make up a new dance, but Burger steals the credit when he gains fame doing the dance with one modification.

videos.title: Falafel's in Jail
videos.overview: Falafel is arrested for seemingly making a string of headset robberies. Apple and Onion feel so convinced of his innocence that they make repeated attempts to break him out of jail.

videos.title: The Music Store Thief
videos.overview: Someone is stealing instruments from Ice Tea's music store, right under the nose of Chicken Nugget, who moonlights there as a security guard. Apple and Onion love the store so much that they volunteer to help catch the thief.

videos.title: The Fly
videos.overview: Apple and Onion must get a fly out of their apartment or Falafel will kick them out.

videos.title: Dragonhead
videos.overview: Apple and Onion start a secret city parking lot to raise money for a new shower head.

videos.title: Pulling Your Weight
videos.overview: Apple and Onion start taking workout lessons at the city gym in order to get strong enough to save each other’s life.

videos.title: Rotten Apple
videos.overview: Onion’s dad comes to the city to visit but thinks Apple is a bad influence on Onion.

videos.title: The Inbetween
videos.overview: Apple and Onion have promised they will be there for Falafel's birthday party. However, they find themselves in a mysterious place and don't know how to get out.

videos.title: Election Day
videos.overview: Apple and Onion realize that the Mayor of their city is corrupt and they vow to put an end to that.

videos.title: Champion
videos.overview: Apple and Onion need to get rid of a problematic dog they thought was a horse.

videos.title: Falafel's Passion
videos.overview: Apple and Onion try to help Falafel find his passion but it looks like things might take a humiliating turn.

videos.title: Hole in Roof
videos.overview: Apple and Onion must repair the hole in their roof before the impending storm of the century.

videos.title: Patty's Law
videos.overview: If found guilty of breaking Patty's Law, Apple and Onion face grave punishment but they have a more pressing concern; looking after their dear, sickly Falafel.

videos.title: The Eater
videos.overview: Apple and Onion take on a monster in a parallel universe in order to get back home.

videos.title: Apple & Onion's Booth
videos.overview: Apple and Onion must save their favourite booth at Pizza’s Diner from a Texas oil tycoon.

videos.title: Ferekh
videos.overview: Apple and Onion are put in charge of Falafel’s beloved rooster but it turns out that other parties have a vested interest in it too.

videos.title: Pat on the Head
videos.overview: Apple and Onion are to cook for a very important guest but Onion is not quite feeling himself.

videos.title: Falafel's Glory
videos.overview: Apple and Onion must recruit the help of retired quiz master Falafel if they are to not starve.

videos.title: Christmas Spirit
videos.overview: Apple & Onion know exactly what gifts they want this Christmas but all their money has been squandered. Luckily they find a suitably festive way to make back that money.

videos.title: Slobbery
videos.overview: Burger's roommate is not only a problem for him, but for Apple and Onion who need Burger's help for something else.

videos.title: Microwave's Dance Cub
videos.overview: DJ Saltfish and MC Ackee are in town for two nights only and Apple and Onion are determined to make the most of it and bust some moves on the dance floor.

videos.title: All Work and No Play
videos.overview: Having finally saved up and aquired an expensive toy race track, Apple and Onion are faced with one problem- there is no time to play with it.

videos.title: Drone Shoes
videos.overview: Can there exist such a thing as drone shoes? It sounds like they would need a huge power capacity.

videos.title: Walking on the Ceiling
videos.overview: Apple's curiosity of what it would be like to walk upside down like a spider should be ignored and given no further thought. It is not.

videos.title: Keep It Fresh
videos.overview: It's Apple's turn to buy this months' groceries again meaning that the risk of starvation is at hand.

videos.title: Panamanian Night Monkey
videos.overview: Apple and Onion must adopt unorthodox measures if they are to see this special animal at the zoo.

videos.title: Za
videos.overview: Pizza's Diner needs a makeover. Apple and Onion better get this right or Pizza is ruined.

videos.title: Broccoli
videos.overview: Apple and Onion must get Hoagie to finish replacing their building's roof so that they can get on with their lives.

videos.title: Cousin's Day
videos.overview: It's Cousin's Day- another holiday the corporations made up to make more money and Apple and Onion are going to capitalize on it.

videos.title: Nothing Can Stop Us
videos.overview: Hot Dog has the audition of his life but he is missing something crucial. Apple and Onion are tasked with bringing it to him and they are adamant that nothing will stand in their way.

videos.title: Good Job
videos.overview: Falafel is starting to feel very underappreciated as the building's handyman. What's the point in all this back breaking work if not a single person will ever tell him, "Good Job"?

videos.title: One Hit Wonder
videos.overview: Apple and Onion have to keep a couple together so they can sing their new love song at the couple’s wedding.

videos.title: A Matter of Pride
videos.overview: Apple and Onion quit their demeaning jobs at the Dollar Store as a matter of pride.

videos.title: Eyesore a Sunset
videos.overview: Art is subjective and Apple and Onion agree to let that get between them.

videos.title: For Queen and Country
videos.overview: Onion has an unexpected and impossible new love interest. Off to England then.

videos.title: Petri
videos.overview: Apple and Onion must get back to their apartment to put the lid back on a dangerous petri dish.

videos.title: Lowlifes
videos.overview: Apple & Onion cannot allow themselves to be viewed by society- and more importantly by smug old Chicken Nugget-as lowlifes.

videos.title: Falafel's Car Keys
videos.overview: Apple & Onion are deemed responsible enough to borrow Falafel's car for their first road trip together. Nothing will go wrong, and they're going to make sure of that… by getting some practice in.

videos.title: Sneakerheads
videos.overview: Apple & Onion need a Last Will and Testament if they are to protect their belongings from the state.

videos.title: Filthy Rich
videos.overview: What does it take to be truly content? Whatever it takes, Apple and Onion are going to achieve it.

videos.title: Truffle Season
videos.overview: It’s Truffle Season, Apple and Onion are Truffle Hunters and they will stop at nothing to taste a truffle.

videos.title: Lambporcini
videos.overview: Apple and Onion are very happy with their sweet new matching designer outfits they bought from known scam-artist Street Dog. That's until Chicken Nugget mistakes them for something they are not.

videos.title: Jerk Chicken
videos.overview: In pursuit of the American Dream, Apple and Onion start their own business. However, a rather troublesome customer stands in their way.

videos.title: Open House Cookies
videos.overview: Jerk Chicken is selling his house and Apple and Onion have been showing a lot of interest which definitely has nothing to do with the delicious cookies out on offer.

videos.title: World Cup
videos.overview: It's time to relax in the expensive massage chairs that Apple & Onion have rented for the month. It's also time for the Football (soccer) World Cup and Falafel's team, Egypt are in the tournament.

videos.title: Win It or Bin It
videos.overview: Apple and Onion are about to take ownership of a brand new luxury penthouse apartment and be rid of their roof shack for ever! All they need is a good reference from a previous landlord… Falafel.
